title: Crispy Miso–Coriander Chicken Wings
description: Crisp wings with white miso, toasted coriander, ginger and garlic, accompanied by a hoisin-forward dipping sauce.
origin: Scaled threefold from the original 500 g wing batch. The long, staged preparation is intentional.
steps: Pat the wings dry, coat with salt and refrigerate for approximately 30 hours. Discard any pooled liquid and pat dry again.
Combine the white miso, toasted coriander, garlic, ginger and white pepper. Add lemongrass only if desired. Coat the wings and refrigerate for approximately 12 hours.
Wipe off thick clumps of miso so they do not scorch. Place the wings on a rack, uncovered in the refrigerator, for approximately 6 hours.
Dust lightly with starch, shaking off excess. Fry in batches at 165–170°C for about 8–12 minutes depending on size, until crisp and the thickest part reaches at least 74°C.
Gently warm hoisin, water and sugar until smooth. Turn off the heat and add sesame oil. Add rice vinegar only if the dip is too sweet or heavy.
Drain on a rack and serve immediately with the hoisin dip.
notes: Hoisin should remain the dominant flavour; no chilli or additional soy sauce is required.
White miso salinity varies by brand; the original calculation used a provisional 12.2% salt for Miyachan miso.
Do not let the miso coating char before the chicken has cooked through.
